trial_court: Additional District Judge 2nd Court Contai, Matrimonial Suit No - 22 of 2018
case_name: Partha Sakha Maity vs Bijali Maity
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: The petitioner husband is aggrieved by the order passed in J. Misc Case No-11 of 2018 and the respondent wife is aggrieved by the order passed in Matrimonial Suit No - 22/2018.

legal_principles.principle: A court may stay all further proceedings by the husband until the whole of wife's taxed costs have been paid or secured and security given for the wife's further costs.
legal_principles.held: His Lordship held that such an order was in strict accordance with the old practice of the Ecclesiastical Courts and his Lordship followed with approval an earlier decision on the point.

legal_principles.principle: A court may order the respondent to pay to the petitioner the expenses of the proceeding and monthly during the proceeding such sum as having regard to the petitioner's own income and the income of the respondent it may seem to the Court to be reasonable.
legal_principles.held: Section 24 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 provides that where in any proceedings under this Act it appears to the Court that either the wife or the husband has no independent income sufficient for her or his support...
cited_cases: Rajnesh V. Neha and Another, (2021) 2 SCC 324

outcome.final_order: The court modified the previous orders.

keywords: Protection of Women from DV Act
